data.label: 阿里云云解析DNS
data.description: 阿里云云解析DNS深度融合公共云与IDC解析能力，实现全场景覆盖、全链路解析与一站式管理，为企业提供全面、易用、高效的平台化域名解析服务。无论多云、混合云架构，还是移动应用与物联网场景，均可灵活适配，助力企业降本增效，构建稳定可靠的网络环境。

data.label: Alibaba Cloud DNS
data.description: Alibaba Cloud DNS is a managed domain name resolution platform that provides end-to-end DNS services for enterprises across public networks, private networks, and mobile applications. It covers multicloud, hybrid cloud, and Internet of Things (IoT) use cases.
